Results.ReviewText:
This 22" Premium Kettle was purchased to replace one that was several years old that had seen a lot of use. The new one is still a Weber and still works, but it's changed, and not necessarily for the better. 

There is now only one handle on the bowl, which means less tools can be hung, and it's much more difficult to move. Living in the Midwest, I have relied on that extra handle on many occasions to help move my kettle to safety during unexpected weather. 

The other thing I noticed seems to be quality control. The inside of the bowl was not coated evenly with the porcelain enamel. It looks like there are drips you would see with a poorly done spray paint application.
Results.Title: New But Not Improved

Results.ReviewText: This is my second weber kettle, the first being the basic one. I am glad I upgraded this time around, this one is really easy to clean ashes from. The versatility of a weber kettle allows direct/indirect grilling as well as smoking. The flavor of charcoal cooking over gas makes the extra time to startup worth it. I highly recommend getting this Weber kettle even if you keep your gas grill. At todays meat prices, why not optimize their flavor and enjoyment?
Results.Title: Worth the extra money!

Results.ReviewText: Does everything I need it to. Chicken, sausage, burgers and I’m working my way up to more involved grilling. Temp gauge is very handy and the ash bowl is worth the upgrade from the basic alone! Very satisfied with my first Weber!

Results.ReviewText:
I'm loving it so far. Because of its simplicity, it's VERY easy to clean. This was the big problem I had with my previous grill which made it not last as long. Simply allow the ashes to collect at the bottom, remove the grate and scrap them through the holes at the bottom of the bowl - easy! The handle to the ash collector is genius and easy to remove. 

Because of the ease of cleaning, I can tell that this grill is going to last a very long time. 

Keeping in mind that I love this grill, here's a minor con. I wish that the coal grate could be secured to the lips that keep it in place. If I move the grill slightly, that grate falls out of place. It doesn't keep me from grilling but it is a small pain to place it back on the lips. To keep that from happening, make sure the grill is where you want it before you begin to grill. That way, it won't slide off. Also be sure to use a long coal rake to move the coals around or the grate will slip off in that as well.

I still love it and look forward to years of use.
Results.Title: Loving it!

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
